zh-CN.eyebrow: 面向 Windows 的命令行文档工具
zh-CN.title: 从 Markdown 出发，完成可重复的文档交付。
zh-CN.description: FloraDoc 从 Markdown 构建 DOCX、XLSX 和可离线阅读的 HTML 文档/幻灯片，并支持 DOCX 模板填充。
zh-CN.intro: 围绕一份可读、可维护的 Markdown 源文件，构建多格式文档、管理样式与模板，并检查结果和诊断。
zh-CN.workflowTitle: 让文件保持清晰，让交付过程可追踪
zh-CN.workflowBody: 将 Markdown、图片与可选格式资源放入项目工作区，通过 floradoc CLI 选择目标格式并生成文档。
zh-CN.screenshotCaption: 来自 FloraDoc 桌面应用的真实界面截图。
zh-CN.screenshotPendingBody: 正式产品截图尚未收录。我们会在确认当前版本界面后补充。
zh-CN.releaseBody: Windows x64 Preview 现已提供安装器和便携 ZIP；下载页列出系统要求、发行说明和 SHA-256。
zh-CN.docsBody: 公开指南包含项目初始化、DOCX/XLSX/HTML 构建、模板填充、常用参数和可复制的 PowerShell 示例。
zh-CN.supportBody: 公开反馈渠道尚未配置。发布前会补充可用的支持入口。

features.title: 以 Markdown 组织内容
features.summary: 将 Markdown 文件作为文档构建输入，保留源文件与本地图片资源的文件路径。

features.title: 生成 Word 与 Excel 文档
features.summary: 通过 CLI 从 Markdown 创建 DOCX，或用 JSON 数据填充 DOCX 模板。DOCX 支持 Style、经验证的 Office-native Template 和结构检查。

features.title: 生成 XLSX 与离线 HTML
features.summary: 从同一份 Markdown 创建 XLSX 工作簿、离线 HTML 文档或 HTML 幻灯片；表格、图片、分页和格式提示按目标格式渲染。

features.title: 复用样式与 Word 模板
features.summary: 从资源目录查询并选择 Style 与支持的 DOCX 模板；当前不支持 XLSX 原生 Office Template。

features.title: 项目工作区与资源管理
features.summary: 通过 floradoc init 创建可选项目配置；按项目安全边界组织 Markdown、图片、格式文件、模板和输出。

features.title: 工具与流程执行
features.summary: 按 Manifest 调用工具，也可执行带输入、步骤和输出映射的工作流。

features.title: DOCX 提取、重建与比较
features.summary: 可提取文档模型、语义重建、恢复原包并生成比较报告；不支持或未评估的结构会单独诊断。

features.title: PowerPoint 构建
features.summary: 已有 Markdown 到 PPTX 的模板与页面构建链路；整体视觉验收仍需完成，因此目前列为实验性。

scenarios.title: 样式化技术文档
scenarios.body: 使用 Markdown 和 Style 生成 DOCX，或通过 JSON 数据填充 DOCX 模板。

scenarios.title: 结构化表格输出
scenarios.body: 将表格和图片生成 XLSX，或导出单文件离线 HTML 文档/演示稿。

scenarios.title: 可复查的自动化构建
scenarios.body: 使用结构化 CLI 结果和诊断，让每次生成都可检查。

faqs.question: 现在可以下载 FloraDoc 吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。当前公开的是 FloraDoc 0.1.7 Windows x64 Preview，下载页提供真实安装器、便携 ZIP、系统要求和 SHA-256。

faqs.question: 支持哪些系统？
faqs.answer: 当前 Preview 面向 Windows 10 或更新版本的 x64 系统；不需要安装 .NET SDK、Python 或 Microsoft Word。

faqs.question: 可以把 DOCX 完整往返还原吗？
faqs.answer: DOCX 工具会标记不支持或未评估的结构。语义重建与原包恢复是不同操作，不能据此承诺任意文档都能无损往返。

faqs.question: PPTX 构建已经正式支持了吗？
faqs.answer: 构建链路已实现，但整体视觉验收尚未完成，因此网站将其标为实验性功能。

faqs.question: 如何安装 FloraDoc？
faqs.answer: 可使用安装器配置 PATH，也可解压便携 ZIP 后直接运行 floradoc.exe。安装器版可使用 floradoc update；便携 ZIP 不支持该更新流程。

faqs.question: 可以处理哪些文件格式？
faqs.answer: 输入为 Markdown；当前支持 DOCX 创建与模板填充、XLSX、单文件 HTML 文档和 HTML 幻灯片。PPTX 仍属实验性，XLSX 原生模板暂不支持。

faqs.question: 如何校验下载文件？
faqs.answer: 正式版本会显示每个发行文件的 SHA-256。下载后可在 Windows PowerShell 使用 Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <文件路径>，并与页面值核对。

faqs.question: 如何获取更新？
faqs.answer: 通过安装器安装的用户可运行 floradoc update。更新器通过 HTTPS 获取版本说明和安装器，并在启动前校验 SHA-256。便携 ZIP 请手动下载新版。

faqs.question: 遇到问题时在哪里反馈？
faqs.answer: 公开反馈渠道尚未配置。反馈入口会在确认可用后添加到网站。

faqs.question: 在哪里可以查看命令实例？
faqs.answer: 打开导航中的“使用文档”，查看项目初始化、DOCX/XLSX/HTML 构建、模板填充和更新器的 PowerShell 命令示例。

en.eyebrow: A command-line document builder for Windows
en.title: Start with Markdown. Deliver documents you can review and repeat.
en.description: FloraDoc builds DOCX, XLSX, and offline HTML documents or slide decks from Markdown, and fills DOCX templates with JSON data.
en.intro: Build multiple document formats from readable Markdown, select styles and templates, and inspect results and diagnostics.
en.workflowTitle: Keep the files clear. Make the process traceable.
en.workflowBody: Keep Markdown, images, and optional format resources in a project workspace. Use the floradoc CLI to select an output format and build the file.
en.screenshotCaption: A genuine screenshot from the FloraDoc desktop application.
en.screenshotPendingBody: An approved product screenshot has not been added yet. We will add one after confirming the current application version.
en.releaseBody: The Windows x64 Preview is available as an installer and portable ZIP. The download page lists requirements, release notes, and SHA-256 values.
en.docsBody: The public guide covers project setup, DOCX/XLSX/HTML builds, template filling, common options, and copy-ready PowerShell examples.
en.supportBody: A public support channel has not been configured yet. A verified contact option will be added before release.

features.title: Markdown as the content source
features.summary: Build from Markdown files while keeping source documents and local image assets as regular files.

features.title: Word and Excel output
features.summary: Create DOCX files from Markdown or fill DOCX templates with JSON data. DOCX supports Styles, supported native templates, and structural validation.

features.title: XLSX and offline HTML output
features.summary: Build XLSX workbooks, offline HTML documents, or HTML slide decks from the same Markdown source. Tables, images, page breaks, and render hints are handled per target.

features.title: Reusable styles and Word templates
features.summary: Browse and select Styles and supported DOCX templates from the resource catalog. Native XLSX Office templates are not currently supported.

features.title: Project workspace and resources
features.summary: Use floradoc init for optional project settings and keep Markdown, images, formats, templates, and outputs within the project boundary.

features.title: Tools and workflow execution
features.summary: Run tools through manifests and execute workflows with mapped inputs, steps, and outputs.

features.title: DOCX extraction, rebuild, and comparison
features.summary: Extract a document model, rebuild semantically, restore the original package, and produce comparison reports. Unsupported or unevaluated structures are diagnosed.

features.title: PowerPoint builds
features.summary: A Markdown-to-PPTX template and page-build path is implemented. Full visual acceptance is still pending, so this capability is experimental.

scenarios.title: Styled technical documents
scenarios.body: Create a styled DOCX from Markdown or fill a DOCX template with JSON data.

scenarios.title: Structured spreadsheet output
scenarios.body: Build XLSX tables and images, or export a single-file offline HTML document or presentation.

scenarios.title: Reviewable automation
scenarios.body: Inspect structured CLI results and diagnostics after each build.

faqs.question: Can I download FloraDoc today?
faqs.answer: Yes. FloraDoc 0.1.7 Preview for Windows x64 is published with a real installer, portable ZIP, system requirements, and SHA-256 values.

faqs.question: Which systems are supported?
faqs.answer: The current Preview targets Windows 10 or later on x64. The package does not require the .NET SDK, Python, or Microsoft Word.

faqs.question: Can every DOCX round-trip without loss?
faqs.answer: The DOCX tools report structures that are unsupported or not evaluated. Semantic rebuild and package restore are separate operations, so lossless round-trip behavior is not promised for every document.

faqs.question: Is PPTX generation officially supported?
faqs.answer: The build path is implemented, but full visual acceptance is incomplete. The site labels it experimental.

faqs.question: How do I install FloraDoc?
faqs.answer: Use the installer to configure PATH, or extract the portable ZIP and run floradoc.exe. Installer users can run floradoc update; the portable ZIP does not support that update flow.

faqs.question: Which file formats can FloraDoc handle?
faqs.answer: Markdown input supports DOCX creation and template filling, XLSX, single-file HTML documents, and HTML slide decks. PPTX remains experimental; native XLSX templates are not supported yet.

faqs.question: How do I verify a download?
faqs.answer: Each published file will have a SHA-256 value. After downloading on Windows, run Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <file-path> in PowerShell and compare the result with the value on the site.

faqs.question: How do I get updates?
faqs.answer: Run floradoc update for an installer-based installation. The updater reads version notes and downloads over HTTPS, verifies SHA-256, then starts the installer. Portable ZIP users should download a new archive manually.

faqs.question: Where can I report a problem?
faqs.answer: A public feedback channel has not been configured yet. A verified contact option will be added when available.

faqs.question: Where can I find command examples?
faqs.answer: Open Documentation for PowerShell examples covering project setup, DOCX/XLSX/HTML builds, template filling, and updates.
